question.en: What film and processing route are used?
question.zh-cn: 使用什么胶片与处理工艺？

summary.en: Keep film format, image type and chemistry in separate fields.
summary.zh-cn: 分别记录胶片规格、影像类型与处理工艺。

boundary.en: Negative/reversal describes the resulting image; C-41 names a processing route. Neither specifies the viewing path.
boundary.zh-cn: 负片或反转片描述成像结果，C-41 描述处理流程，二者都不能指定取景结构。
